items.title: Why Is Sandisk (SNDK) Stock Sliding After A Shock AI Leadership Exit?
items.summary: Sandisk (NasdaqGS:SNDK) traded lower on 16 November 2026 after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following personal controversy reports. The leadership change at Nvidia coincided with a broad retreat in AI focused semiconductor stocks that are linked through shared demand trends. Sandisk, which supplies memory products used in AI and data infrastructure, moved in line with other chipmakers during the sector pullback.
